# sdd-kit-drupal

Drupal 11 add-on: drupal-backend-dev agent, drupal-11 skill with module scaffolding and the Drupal stack manifest.

- Version: 4.0.1
- Keywords: drupal, php

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add stasmarkov/sdd-kit
/plugin install sdd-kit-drupal@sdd-kit
```
